author: DaMuricanPatriot
body:
Age: 11 (My age is rather young, but I think I will have an ability at moderating and I will not abuse my privileges.)
Timezone: Eastern Standard Time
Do you have Teamspeak? I don't, but if it requires it I will get TeamSpeak.
Do you have Discord? Yes, and this is what I use to communicate instead of TS.
Do you have access to a recording software? I will get one soon, but currently I do not have one.


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?

I do not have much experience, although I will attempt to be a moderator the best I can, and will not let my lack of experience bring me down.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness I would say is activity, school and home can affect me and my activity, although I will try to be on as  much as I can.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

I would say the qualities a leader must have are resilience, good work ethic, and the ability to stay one step ahead. I would consider myself a leader because I do not give up and stay happy with what I do, as I am a very optimistic person and I will stay happy. I am often one step ahead because I always look at other problems that could occur, and find ways to solve such problem.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I would say that I stand out from the other players because I always have a tendency to help. I will always want to be there when one is in trouble, and/or when one is causing a problem. I will also use very great grammar to make sure that I can communicate and make sure the other person can comprehend what I am saying.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

I believe that you should interact with the community in a nice manner and not begin any toxicity. This is an important subject in moderation because as a moderator, others look up to you as an example and being rude would think that is allowed. Also, another skill to have is to be able to take complaints people have about you. And finally, be able to interact with them with their language, as in here, English. I meet this criteria as I am nice to others, and I can take people being toxic to me, it has happened in many cases before. I can communicate in many languages, but my main language is English so I am capable to speaking with others on the server.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

One of three traits moderators should have is optimism, as if they were saddened they could make many mistakes and not be able to have the second important trait, Work Ethic. Work ethic is important because it is what motivates you to do your job, and be able to do it without dreading it. Without such trait, this can either make you quit your moderation, not do great at your job, or just get stripped of your privilages as you lose interist and you do something wrong. The final trait is strictness. This is urgent because with this trait this can make you have the abilty to take out rule breakers with ease and not feel bad, which can lead to Work ethic and Optimism. Without being strict and being too nice then you would just not be able to ban even a simple spammer.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

I would notify as many staff members, and try to find as much evidence as I can, and make sure to keep watch. I would also try to see why such evidence on many bans is insufficent and find the ones without evidence. I would try to keep this as a top priority untill this moderator is fired.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

Since this is allowed in this channel, I would not notify any has it would not make sense to try to ban this person, but I would keep much suspision on the people involved. If anything is done outside this channel, I would take action.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would instantly take action, even though the information is not important and not very needed, I would try to notify any people in higher command, as I would not want to have any information leaked about the staff discord.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

Once I begin to notice the joke, I would first try to tell them to stop and maybe tune it down a little and not affect the server in such a way. If they continue, I would begin to restore the harrassment done as soon as they do it, and try to capture evidence. Although I will try to keep this as a not very important subject as they would most likely stop as I say it, and if they don't, it would not be that much of a big deal as I can simply send the evidence to as many places to show this, and maybe even try to have a private discord chat with the staff members causing this tyrannical situation.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Why do you want to be a moderator?

I want to become moderator because I have been playing on this server for a very VERY long while, (since MC zone still existed) and I see that I want to help people rather new, and I also just want to be helpful to the server.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What does Avicus mean to you?

I see Avicus as a server full of great potential, and great people. Although some people are not exactly the "Nicest," I still like the server very much, and I see avicus as an amazing server that everyone should play.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Anything specific the staff team could do better?

I would say that they should most likely try to maybe put more emphasis on making the server more mainstream like voting, adverts, just over all spreading the server to other people to reach it's former glory again.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

I chose to apply to Avicus as the server is one of my favorite servers while also being my most nostalgic one, and I just love the server. It has some of my fondest memories, and one of the main reasons why I still play minecraft today.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Not really, I think that what I said is solid, and that is that.
